تخترعن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِعْنَ (taḵtariʕna) /tax.ta.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# تُخْتَرَعْنَ (tuḵtaraʕna) /tux.ta.raʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
